On Thu, Jul 7, 2022 at 3:20 PM Adam Siegel <[contact omitted]> wrote:
This is really encouraging in my view. I generally have very positive reactions and like the idea of trying to move out
on many of these fronts with speed.
On country prioritization, both for civil society trainings and Trusted Flaggers, I agree with Vera's take here. As a first
step to seeing if/how these kinds of partnerships would work, I'd support prioritizing countries where we've had senior
leadership (A/AID and DA Coleman/DA Adams-Allen) travel, given that they almost certainly engaged with civil
society there; and places where DRG has some priorities or particular focus at the moment.
On the question regarding LPA, I spoke to Vera and asked that she follow-up with Jodi to see about potential interest
in general comms engagement. In terms of the Administrator doing interviews with YT creators, I communicated that
we're certainly happy to consider. We have done and been offered similar things in the past. We would basically filter
this the same way as any other media request: audience size, reach, what priorities does it advance, etc.
Finally, on Creator Cohorts: we talked about something like this in general terms when we met with the YT CEO. It
sounds great, although of course we should review a concept proposal with rigorous scrutiny we would give any
partnership with one of these tech companies. But the concept is really interesting. My personal view is that it makes
sense to pick a region to pilot this if it goes forward. I like the idea of LAC and know that AA Escobari has had her
own YT engagements. My reasoning is just that it may be helpful to have a Bureau that is helping organizing things,
bring forward the best candidates, and such. If it goes well, it may also make it easier to scale as there will be a
process in place that other Bureaus can follow, rather than having to pitch and re-educate new Missions each time.
But overall fully support moving forward with next steps.
Please let me know how I can be helpful on any of this.
Adam
